rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Perempuan spektral tua bermoncong runcing dan bermata iblis, berpakaian putih sepenuhnya.

visual_requirements.description: Penyihir perempuan tua, wajah bermoncong runcing, dua mata iblis, busana putih buram.
Tangan meraih untuk membekap mulut penidur; ancaman pernapasan tanpa aura.
Kamar penidur dilihat dari posisi rendah di bantal.

aura: Kedekatan ancaman tangan pembekap c06 dan wajah runcing bermata iblis c05.
artistic_choices: Tanpa korban tampak; sudut pandang penidur menekankan teror tanpa kekerasan eksplisit.
Cahaya bulan satu sumber dan tekstur seprai editorial. Tidak memadukan varian kucing hitam c02. Ukuran manusia dipertahankan dengan framing dekat.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Pantafica, the spectral old witch of Abruzzese nightmare folklore.
ANATOMY: one elderly female spectral witch with a sharply pointed long muzzle-like face, two demonic but naturally reflective dark eyes, one head, two arms with normal five-finger hands, opaque long white layered dress covering her entire body and shoulders [pantafica-c01, pantafica-c05].
MOMENT: looming abruptly over the viewer from the bedside, leaning forward with an open hand coming directly toward the camera as if about to cover a sleeper's mouth, the other hand braced on the mattress; piercing stare and taut predatory face [pantafica-c06].
POWER: physical nightmare oppression through that reaching hand, no visible spell or aura.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low viewpoint from a pillow, human-sized figure fills the entire square by proximity, pointed face and grasping hand largest.
LIGHT & WEATHER: a single narrow moonbeam from a small window rakes her pointed face and frayed white cloth, deep brown-black shadow.
SURFACE: weathered skin, aged coarse linen, rumpled bedclothes.
SETTING: a dark sleeper's modest bedroom in Abruzzo, mattress edge and pillow foreground [pantafica-c01].
MOOD: terrifying, imminent and oppressive, never a calm portrait or ordinary woman.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no other person visible, no gore, no nudity; no horns, wings or invented limbs; one head, two eyes, two hands; no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
